title: TROVE: A Challenge for Fine-Grained Text Provenance via Source Sentence Tracing and Relationship Classification
task_description: Trace generated text back to source sentences and classify the relationship between source and generated sentence.
inputs: Source documents; generated sentences; source-sentence candidates.
outputs_or_labels: Source sentence links; relationship labels; provenance tracing scores.
pipeline_gap_filled: Final-generation provenance retention with fine-grained source-span/sentence lineage.
evidence_basis: ACL page and paper title/abstract; official repository located by search.
limitations: Sentence-level rather than token/claim-level; primarily source tracing, not a complete multi-stage transformation suite.
why_relevant: Closest located benchmark to explicit output-to-source lineage and relationship preservation.

title: AttributionBench: How Hard is Automatic Attribution Evaluation?
task_description: Evaluate whether claims in generated answers are supported by cited evidence and assess automatic attribution metrics.
inputs: Generated answers; cited passages; claim/evidence pairs from multiple source datasets.
outputs_or_labels: Claim-level attribution labels and automatic metric comparisons.
pipeline_gap_filled: Claim-to-source support at final generation and evaluator calibration.
artifact_access_status: official paper and GitHub repository located
evidence_basis: ACL Anthology abstract describes cited-evidence attribution evaluation; official project page/repository located.
limitations: Evaluates attribution rather than tracking lineage through extraction, compression, or selection; source spans are not a full transformation graph.
why_relevant: Reusable claim-level attribution testbed and metric baseline for the final stage.

title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
task_description: End-to-end retrieval and answer generation with citations; score answer quality and citation correctness/completeness.
inputs: Information-seeking questions; retrieved passages; generated answers.
outputs_or_labels: Answers with citations; citation correctness and completeness metrics; human judgments.
pipeline_gap_filled: Final generation citation grounding and support-set preservation.
evidence_basis: ACL paper page and Princeton NLP ALCE repository.
limitations: Citations usually point to retrieved passages rather than explicit source spans; no controlled extraction-to-compression lineage.
why_relevant: Strong final-stage benchmark for whether transformations preserve enough evidence to cite.

title: KILT: a Benchmark for Knowledge Intensive Language Tasks
task_description: Unify knowledge-intensive tasks over a fixed Wikipedia snapshot and score both task performance and provenance of supporting passages.
inputs: Questions, claims, entity/linking or fact-checking instances; fixed knowledge source.
outputs_or_labels: Task outputs plus provenance passage IDs and provenance-aware metrics.
pipeline_gap_filled: Selection/retrieval provenance retention into downstream task outputs.
evidence_basis: NAACL paper explicitly describes provenance-aware evaluation and unified fixed knowledge source; official repository located.
limitations: Mostly retrieval/task-level provenance; does not evaluate arbitrary abstractive transformations or token-level lineage.
why_relevant: Provides a concrete provenance-bearing benchmark contract and stable source snapshot.

title: RAGTruth: A Hallucination Corpus for Developing Trustworthy Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
task_description: Detect and localize unsupported or contradictory spans in RAG outputs against retrieved context.
inputs: Retrieved contexts; generated responses across domains and tasks.
outputs_or_labels: Word-level and case-level hallucination spans; response-level labels.
pipeline_gap_filled: Local source-support retention and failure localization after generation.
evidence_basis: ACL abstract states word-level hallucination annotations in standard RAG settings; official repository located.
limitations: Labels unsupportedness rather than positive claim-to-source lineage; does not model intermediate transformations.
why_relevant: Useful negative/positive span-level diagnostic for provenance loss at the output boundary.

title: FaithJudge (title observed in search; identity unresolved)
task_description: Search result suggested a RAG faithfulness benchmark with claim/evidence judgments, but the scholarly identity was not verified.
evidence_basis: Search lead only; no stable official scholarly page, identifier, authors, or artifact was successfully opened.
limitations: Exclude from ranking and implementation until independently verified.
why_relevant: Preserves a failed/blocked lead without converting a snippet into evidence.

title: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation
task_description: Decompose long-form outputs into atomic facts and verify each fact against retrieved or knowledge-source evidence.
inputs: Long-form generated biographies or answers; retrieved evidence.
outputs_or_labels: Atomic facts; support/unsupported labels; factual precision score.
pipeline_gap_filled: Atomic-claim decomposition and evidence verification at final generation.
evidence_basis: ACL paper and official code repository; paper identity is established.
limitations: Measures factual precision, not full lineage identity or source-span continuity; recall/completeness is not the primary target.
why_relevant: A practical atomic-claim layer that can be inserted between summarization and provenance auditing.

title: Evaluating the Factuality of Abstractive Text Summarization
task_description: Evaluate factual consistency of abstractive summaries with human error annotations and automatic metrics.
outputs_or_labels: Human factual-error labels, error categories, summary-level factuality judgments.
pipeline_gap_filled: Summarization faithfulness control benchmark; no explicit citation lineage.
evidence_basis: ACL paper establishes FRANK and human factuality annotations; code repository located.
limitations: No source IDs/spans or transformation graph; factual consistency can hold while provenance is lost.
why_relevant: Important control: demonstrates the gap between summary factuality and explicit source-lineage preservation.

title: On Faithfulness and Factuality in Abstractive Summarization
task_description: Use question generation and answering to test whether summary content is entailed by the source document.
outputs_or_labels: Generated questions/answers; entailment or consistency judgments.
pipeline_gap_filled: Source-to-summary semantic preservation control, without explicit span lineage.
evidence_basis: ACL paper establishes the task and faithfulness/factuality distinction; repository located.
limitations: Indirect semantic test; no citation IDs, source spans, or selection/compression lineage.
why_relevant: Useful baseline for separating semantic faithfulness from provenance retention.

title: The Attribution–Compression Frontier in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
task_description: Measure citation attribution under context compression and compare reranking, extractive selection, abstractive summarization, and token pruning across budgets.
inputs: Retrieved contexts; compressed contexts produced by multiple transformation methods; questions and generated answers.
outputs_or_labels: Citation attribution scores versus compression budget and method; answer quality comparisons.
pipeline_gap_filled: Directly tests provenance retention through selection and compression before generation.
artifact_access_status: official preprint located; artifact not verified
evidence_basis: arXiv abstract/page explicitly names compression methods, attribution, citation, and budgets.
limitations: 2026 preprint; artifact/reproducibility status unresolved; likely measures citation attribution rather than complete token-level lineage.
why_relevant: Most direct located benchmark framing for the requested compression/selection-to-citation pathway.

title: Traceable Text: Deepening Reading of AI-Generated Summaries with Phrase-Level Provenance Links
task_description: Attach phrase-level provenance links from generated summaries to source text and study traceability for human verification.
pipeline_gap_filled: Phrase-level summary provenance visualization and human-auditability evaluation.
evidence_basis: arXiv page describes phrase-level provenance links and traceable-text interaction primitive.
limitations: Not a broad benchmark suite; provenance links may be generated post hoc and do not necessarily evaluate preservation across controlled transformations.
why_relevant: Provides an inspectable output artifact and human-facing provenance criterion.
